name: partyfun
description: A shared whiteboard your team and AI agents work on together, live.

interface.longDescription: PartyFun is a whiteboard of sticky notes, frames, docs and arrows that your team and AI work on together. Open a board beside the conversation and watch the changes land as they're made; what you select on it is shared as context. Sort and prioritize workshop notes, turn a retro into a plan, write a doc from a brainstorm, or lay out a flow.
defaultPrompt: Group the notes on my retro board by theme
Turn the selected notes into a prioritized plan
